title: Spruce Power Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Operating income up 10% year-over-year in the second quarter Net income attributable to stockholders of $3.3 million Record Operating EBITDA of $26.5 million $81.5 million of c ash, $4.24 per share Spruce Power Holding Corporation (NYSE: SPRU) (“Spruce”, "Spruce Power" or the “Company”), a leading owner and operator of distributed solar energy assets across the United States, today reported financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. Second Quarter 2026 Business Highlights Delivered a solid financial performance, achieving operating income of $9.8 million for the quarter compared to $8.9 million in the second quarter of 2025 Net income attributable to stockholders of $3.3 million for the quarter compared to net loss attributable to stockholders of $3.0 million for the year-earlier period Net income attributable to stockholders of $0.6 million for the first half of 2026 compared to net loss attributable to stockholders of $18.2 million for the year-earlier-period
